summary_md: **Jamlee ([@lokiscripter](https://x.com/lokiscripter/status/2115427316553904129))** (in Chinese) describes **ai-memory** (akitaonrails), an MIT single-Rust-binary that gives 20+ harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and more) one shared long-term memory: lifecycle hooks capture prompts and tool calls, sessions become grep-able markdown wiki pages, and typed hand-offs let you switch engines with `ai-memory run codex`.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - akitaonrails/ai-memory: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

relevance: A detailed cross-agent memory and hand-off design with default zero-LLM-call capture.
